description: Daily price points for one AI model over a window. days 1 to 7 is free; days 8 to 90 costs 1 credit ($0.02) and needs a TENSORFEED_TOKEN, adding the min/max/delta summary over the longer window. Get credits at tensorfeed.ai/developers/agent-payments.

days.description: Window length (default 7). 1 to 7 free; 8 to 90 costs 1 credit.

model.description: Model id or display name (e.g. "Claude Opus 5.5" or "claude-opus-5-5").
